3368-4739.notablePrerequisites: You control six or more creatures.
3368-4739.description:
Cast Battle Hymn by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {4}{R}{R}, creating a copy of Battle Hymn and returning Reiterate to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Battle Hymn, adding at least six {R}.
Repeat from step 2.

553-819-5957.description:
During the opponent's end step immediately before your turn, cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W} using Kianne.
In response, cast Memory Lapse by paying its mana cost, putting Approach of the Sun on top of your library.
In your draw step, draw Approach of the Second Sun.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, winning the game.

1621-2146-6867-7183.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Wispweaver Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Wispweaver Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Wispweaver Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

215-850-3499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creatures with defender.
215-850-3499.description:
Activate Overgrown Battlement by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Overgrown Battlement from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Overgrown Battlement by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3967-5571-7666--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Cinderhaze Wretch's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it.

When the creature token enters, Elegant Entourage triggers, giving Cinderhaze Wretch +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Cinderhaze Wretch ability from step 2, untapping it.
Repeat.

457-1792-4404-4668.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least one card this turn.

Cast Corridor Monitor by paying {U} due to Heliod
When Corridor Monitor enters, it triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Retraction Helix.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Corridor Monitor, adding {U}.
Activate the creature targeted by Retraction Helix by tapping it, returning Corridor Monitor from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4050-6972-7322.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Big Mother Mouser.
When Big Mother Mouser dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

141-2510-7301.notablePrerequisites: There is a creature card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
141-2510-7301.description:
Cast Avatar's Wrath by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost reduced by Semblance Anvil.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Avatar's Wrath
Resolve Avatar's Wrath, airbending Naru Meha.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha from exile by paying {0} due to Semblance Anvil.
Repeat from step 3.

Appa triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.

Repeat from step 2.

261-338-3490-5231.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

147-1532-2438.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-1532-2438.description:
Cast Faith's Reward by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Faith's Reward.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Faith's Reward
Resolve the Faith's Reward copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1129-1978-5517.description:
Activate Harabaz Druid by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Harabaz Druid.
Repeat

2173-2448-2842-5220.easyPrerequisites: It is your precombat main phase.
2173-2448-2842-5220.description:
Activate Goblin Firestarter by sacrificing it.
When Goblin Firestarter dies, Mortuary and Blood Artist trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Goblin Firestarter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Goblin Firestarter ability.
Cast Goblin Firestarter from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

539-4657-5175.easyPrerequisites: You control two mana-producing lands other than Magus of the Candelabra that can tap to produce mana of the color named by Caged Sun.
539-4657-5175.description:
Activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Caged Sun triggers twice, adding {2}.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping the two lands and Magus of the Candelabra.
Repeat.

2933-3499-4013-5798.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Drowner of Hope.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Scions by tapping them, adding {2}.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tapped Eldrazi Scion tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite {C}, and then forego tapping or sacrificing subsequent Eldrazi Scions.

136-3941-4067-6281.description:
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Cadaver Imp.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Cadaver Imp that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Cadaver Imp token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Cadaver Imp from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Coveted Jewel.
Repeat.

2468-4377.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Panoptic Mirror triggers, casting a copy of Walk the Aeons without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2577-4871-6518.description:
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
When Gravecrawler enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Gravecrawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Gravecrawler dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

4871-5626-5686-6415.description:
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing another creature and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning Wriggling Grub from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Wriggling Grub.
When Wriggling Grub dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Wriggling Grub trigger, creating two 1/1 Worm creature tokens.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

457-647-5159-5491.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mishra triggers, creating a token copy of Worldwalker Helm that is a 4/4 Construct artifact creature with haste named Mishra's Warform, and a Map token.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping a Map, adding {U}.
Activate Mishra's Warform by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, creating a token copy of it and a Map token for each Mishra's Warform and/or Worldwalker Helm you control.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping two Maps, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat from step 3.
457-647-5159-5491.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Urza's ability.

549-1365-4853-5330--20.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent was dealt damage this turn.
The creature with bloodthirst does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
549-1365-4853-5330--20.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving the creature with bloodthirst persist until end of turn.
Activate Atog by sacrificing the creature with bloodthirst.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, which enters the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to its bloodthirst ability.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Atog ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1636-1824-5484.notablePrerequisites:
You have not completed or are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation.
You control at least three untapped creatures, one of which must be black.
1636-1824-5484.description:
Cast Acererak the Archlich by tapping three creatures you control, one of which must be black.
When Acererak the Archlich enters the battlefield, its first ability and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Acererak the Archlich trigger, returning it to your hand from the battlefield and causing you to venture into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

2254-2825-3263-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Elite Arcanist.
Elite Arcanist does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least two creature cards in your graveyard.
2254-2825-3263-3525.description:
Activate Elite Arcanist's ability by paying {1} and tapping it, casting a copy of Songs of the Damned without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Songs of the Damned, adding at least {2}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Elite Arcanist.
Repeat.
If you have three or more creature cards in your graveyard, this combo nets infinite mana.

2092-4449-4474.notablePrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle attached to Hateflayer.
Hateflayer does not have summoning sickness.
Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 2 or greater.
2092-4449-4474.description:
Activate Hateflayer by tapping it, adding {R}.
Activate Hateflayer by paying {R} due to Agatha of the Vile Cauldron and untapping it, dealing damage equal to its power to any target.
Repeat.

862-877-1899-2232.description:
Activate Beastcaller Savant by tapping it, adding {G} that can only be spent to cast a creature spell.
Cast Crimson Kobolds by paying {0}.
When Crimson Kobolds enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Beastcaller Savant to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Beastcaller Savant by paying {1} due to Morophon.
When Beastcaller Savant enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Crimson Kobolds to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

168-372-1734.manaNeeded: {4}{W} plus enough mana to pay for command tax, if applicable

Cast Abdel Adrian either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and command tax, if applicable.
Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, exiling Oblivion Ring until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Oblivion Ring leaves the battlefield, triggering its second ability, returning Fiend Hunter from exile to the battlefield.
Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability, exiling Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Oblivion Ring from exile to the battlefield.
Oblivion Ring enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability, exiling Fiend Hunter.
Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, triggering its second ability, returning Abdel Adrian from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

3492-3609-5131.notablePrerequisites:
You have not cast an artifact and/or a creature spell using Muldrotha this turn.
Coretapper does not have summoning sickness.
3492-3609-5131.description:
Activate Coretapper's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Coretapper's second ability by sacrificing it, putting two charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Coretapper from your graveyard by paying {2}.
Repeat each turn.

When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Stadium Vendors enters the battlefield, add {U}{U}.
Repeat.
